svg.title: Its orthogonal complement contains the collapsed configurations of the group, including its centroid. In E use Ng = P −1Nfull g . The admissibility assumption is Nfull g ⊂ran P; hence P identifies these normal spaces isometrically. Omitting any one member of g identifies Nfull g linearly with (R4)|g|−1: the omitted coordinate is minus the sum of the others. In particular
